positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsKeptAsset
positions.frame: what marks the boundary between what one owns and keeps versus what one merely rents or treats as commodity?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same matched-opposition maxim — owned/rented in src-2, commodity/kept-asset in src-3 — and the dimensional reads converge on this pairing: register and style both mint the same antithesis form across the two, value reads both as appeals to autonomy and self-enhancement/competence, conviction locates src-3 at 'principle' with src-2 as its supporting 'claim', and affect finds the same calm-positive settled conviction in both. The two meta/positioning segments (src-1, src-4) describe the document's own scaffolding function rather than making this substantive distinction themselves — their conviction reads land at 'notion', exploratory framing about the artifact's purpose, not a committed directional stance — so they do not join this group.
